name: lance_file::versions::v2_0::writer::Writer::write_page
behavior: write_page consumes each buffer, records current tell/actual payload length, writes padded payload, then Any-wraps either Legacy or Structural description into Direct Page metadata with length=num_rows and priority=row_number. Fixture dir derives from resolved __file__, generator is sibling datagen.rs. No post-generation clean check or checksum validation of the generator itself. Create two temporary output directories and one temporary Cargo target directory; both generate calls are sequential separate cargo-run processes sharing that target directory. For each fixed name, read both whole outputs and compare bytes; mismatch errors immediately. With --write copy first output to checked fixture immediately; otherwise require existing checked fixture equal. Print name/digest after each success. This is per-file validation/publication, not all-six atomic replacement: an earlier fixture may be replaced before a later mismatch/failure.
